name: cockpit
description: Cockpit: mods for Claude Code in the terminal — always-on panels you toggle in /cockpit, guards, prompt, commands and focus

plugins.name: rm-guard
plugins.description: Blocks rm -rf and Remove-Item -Recurse on root, home and drives, plus mkfs, dd and format

plugins.name: env-guard
plugins.description: Protects .env files from reading and writing (Read, Edit, Write, cat and @mention)

plugins.name: git-guard
plugins.description: Blocks destructive git: push --force, reset --hard, clean -f, --no-verify, branch -D

plugins.name: secret-scan
plugins.description: Refuses Write/Edit whose content carries API keys, tokens or private keys

plugins.name: prompt-secret-guard
plugins.description: Stops prompts that contain secrets pasted by mistake from being sent

plugins.name: lockfile-guard
plugins.description: Prevents hand edits to lockfiles (package-lock, yarn.lock, pnpm-lock, Cargo.lock...)

plugins.name: path-jail
plugins.description: Restricts Write/Edit to the project root, the temp folder and ~/.claude (resolves symlinks)

plugins.name: main-branch-guard
plugins.description: Refuses commit, push, merge and rebase while the current branch is main/master

plugins.name: turn-timer
plugins.description: Band above the prompt with duration, tools and tokens of the last turn

plugins.name: tool-tally
plugins.description: /tally opens a pane with the call count per tool

plugins.name: file-trail
plugins.description: /trail opens a pane with the files read and changed in the session

plugins.name: cmd-log
plugins.description: /cmdlog opens a pane with the shell commands, status and duration

plugins.name: git-status-line
plugins.description: Status line with branch, changed files and commits ahead/behind

plugins.name: context-meter
plugins.description: Status line with a context bar and cost; warns at 80% and 90%

plugins.name: rate-limit-watch
plugins.description: Toast when the 5h or 7-day window passes 75/90/95%; /limits lists the usage

plugins.name: session-clock
plugins.description: Status line with session time and number of prompts

plugins.name: concise-mode
plugins.description: /concise turns on short, direct answers, with no introduction or recap

plugins.name: persona
plugins.description: /persona changes Claude's voice: mentor, senior, rubberduck, pirata, yoda, zen

plugins.name: prompt-shortcuts
plugins.description: Shortcuts ::fix, ::test, ::review, ::explain, ::refactor, ::doc, ::commit become full prompts

plugins.name: tldr
plugins.description: Adds a 2-sentence TL;DR (via haiku) below long answers

plugins.name: quick-notes
plugins.description: /note and /notes: quick notes per project, kept between sessions

plugins.name: pomodoro
plugins.description: /pomodoro [min] with a countdown in the status line, toast and notification at the end

plugins.name: copy-last
plugins.description: /copy-last copies the last reply; /copy-code copies the last code block

plugins.name: session-stats
plugins.description: /stats sums up the session: time, prompts, tools, tokens, context and cost

plugins.name: quote-selection
plugins.description: /quote quotes in the prompt the passage selected with the mouse

plugins.name: git-peek
plugins.description: /gs, /gl and /gd: git status, log and diff right away, without spending a model turn

plugins.name: turn-notify
plugins.description: Native notification when a turn of 30s or more finishes

plugins.name: break-reminder
plugins.description: A toast every 50 minutes of session reminding you to take a break

plugins.name: daily-streak
plugins.description: Counts your streak of days using Claude Code; a toast on start and the /streak command

plugins.name: cockpit
plugins.description: Settings pane: /cockpit switches each panel on and off and sets the language of every mod

plugins.name: git-band
plugins.description: Band with the branch, changed files, lines added and removed, ahead/behind and the last commit

plugins.name: todo-band
plugins.description: Project task list pinned above the prompt, clickable and persistent (/todo)

plugins.name: usage-band
plugins.description: Fixed band with colored bars for context, the 5h and 7 day windows, and cost

plugins.name: files-band
plugins.description: Fixed band with the files Claude changed in this session

plugins.name: error-band
plugins.description: Keeps the last failed command and its error line in view until a command passes

plugins.name: goal-band
plugins.description: /goal pins the project goal above the prompt and in Claude's context

plugins.name: agents-band
plugins.description: Band showing in real time how many subagents are running and which ones

plugins.name: activity-status
plugins.description: Live status line with the tool Claude is running right now

plugins.name: test-status
plugins.description: Status line entry with the result of the last test run: passed or failed, time and duration

plugins.name: ci-status
plugins.description: Status line with the state of the last GitHub Actions workflow (via gh)

plugins.name: stash-status
plugins.description: Status line that reminds you how many stashes are saved

plugins.name: uncommitted-band
plugins.description: Warning band when changes have gone uncommitted for more than 45 minutes

plugins.name: pr-status
plugins.description: Status line with the current branch pull request and its review state (via gh)

plugins.name: main-warning-band
plugins.description: Red band while you are on main or master

plugins.name: conflict-band
plugins.description: Band that warns about a merge or rebase in progress and files in conflict

plugins.name: project-status
plugins.description: Status line with the project name and version, Node version and package manager

plugins.name: ports-band
plugins.description: Band with the dev servers running on localhost

plugins.name: deps-status
plugins.description: Status line with how many npm dependencies are outdated

plugins.name: todo-count-status
plugins.description: Status line counting TODO, FIXME and HACK in tracked code

plugins.name: quality-status
plugins.description: Status line with the latest lint, types and build results

plugins.name: model-status
plugins.description: Status line with the model in use in the session

plugins.name: cost-ticker
plugins.description: Status line with the cost of the last turn and the session total

plugins.name: idle-clock
plugins.description: Status line with how long the session has been idle

plugins.name: turn-progress
plugins.description: Live status line with the elapsed time and tool count of the turn in progress

plugins.name: last-prompt-band
plugins.description: Band with your last request, so you do not lose it after long answers

plugins.name: compact-nudge
plugins.description: Band with a compact button when context passes 75%

plugins.name: session-diff-band
plugins.description: Band with the total lines Claude wrote and removed in the session

plugins.name: shield-band
plugins.description: Band with the count of calls blocked by guards and the last reason

plugins.name: reset-countdown
plugins.description: Status line counting down to the reset of the tightest rate limit

plugins.name: spend-today
plugins.description: Status line with today's spend summed across all sessions

plugins.name: focus-band
plugins.description: /focus starts a focus block with a pinned progress bar

plugins.name: deadline-band
plugins.description: /deadline pins a countdown to the project deadline

plugins.name: pin-band
plugins.description: /pin pins up to 4 project reminders above the prompt

plugins.name: clock-status
plugins.description: Status line with the day and time (useful in fullscreen mode)

plugins.name: day-timer
plugins.description: Status line with your active Claude Code time today, summed across sessions

plugins.name: commits-today
plugins.description: Status line with how many commits you made today in this repository

plugins.name: dolar-status
plugins.description: Status line with the dollar rate in Brazilian reais (AwesomeAPI)

plugins.name: weather-status
plugins.description: Status line with the weather in your city (wttr.in)

plugins.name: api-status
plugins.description: Status line with the state of the Anthropic API from its public status page

plugins.name: terminal-pet
plugins.description: A mascot above the prompt that reacts: working, happy, sad or sleepy

plugins.name: git-context
plugins.description: Attaches the git state (branch and changed files) to every prompt as hidden context

plugins.name: stack-context
plugins.description: Detects the project stack (package.json, pom.xml...) and tells Claude in the system prompt

plugins.name: commit-style
plugins.description: Makes Claude write short, imperative Conventional Commits

plugins.name: generated-guard
plugins.description: Prevents edits in node_modules, dist, build, .next, coverage, .git and the like

plugins.name: sql-guard
plugins.description: Blocks DROP, TRUNCATE and DELETE/UPDATE without WHERE in shell commands

plugins.name: prod-guard
plugins.description: Requires your confirmation for deploys, publishes, terraform apply, kubectl and migrations

plugins.name: install-ask
plugins.description: Requires your confirmation whenever Claude is about to install a new dependency

plugins.name: pipe-shell-guard
plugins.description: Blocks curl | sh, wget | bash, iwr | iex and variants

plugins.name: big-read-guard
plugins.description: Refuses reading a file over 512 KB whole and asks for a slice

plugins.name: reply-language
plugins.description: Makes Claude always answer in the language set in the Cockpit hub, keeping code and commands in the original

plugins.name: git-branch
plugins.description: /gb lists local branches with the current one marked, or switches to a branch and creates it when missing

plugins.name: git-stash
plugins.description: /gst stashes the working tree with a message, pops the latest stash after asking, or lists the stashes

plugins.name: git-undo
plugins.description: /gundo shows the last commit and, once you confirm, undoes it with a soft reset; refuses a pushed commit

plugins.name: run-script
plugins.description: /run runs a package.json script with the project's package manager and prints the exit code and last lines

plugins.name: open-path
plugins.description: /open opens a file or folder of the project in the system's default app; refuses paths outside the project

plugins.name: ports
plugins.description: /ports probes the common dev ports on localhost and lists which ones answer

plugins.name: kill-port
plugins.description: /killport finds the process listening on a port, names it and ends it after you confirm

plugins.name: tree
plugins.description: /tree prints the project's directory tree two levels deep, skipping node_modules, .git, build output and dot folders

plugins.name: find-file
plugins.description: /ff lists the tracked files whose path contains a text, best matches first

plugins.name: last-error
plugins.description: /lasterr recalls the most recent shell command that failed this session and the end of its output

plugins.name: env-check
plugins.description: /envcheck compares the keys of .env.example with .env and lists the missing and extra ones, never a value

plugins.name: outdated
plugins.description: /outdated shows npm outdated as an aligned table and counts the major version jumps

plugins.name: json-tool
plugins.description: /json validates and pretty-prints JSON, and says the line and column of a syntax error

plugins.name: uuid
plugins.description: /uuid generates up to 20 random UUIDs and copies them to the clipboard

plugins.name: timestamp
plugins.description: /ts converts epoch seconds, milliseconds, ISO 8601 and local time for now or for any epoch or date

plugins.name: base64
plugins.description: /b64 encodes and decodes Base64 safely for UTF-8 text and copies the result

plugins.name: hash
plugins.description: /hash gives the SHA-256 and SHA-1 of a text in hex and copies the SHA-256

plugins.name: calc
plugins.description: /calc evaluates arithmetic with parentheses and decimals, and says what is wrong with a bad expression

plugins.name: color-tool
plugins.description: /color converts a color between hex, rgb and hsl and reports its WCAG contrast on white and black

plugins.name: regex-test
plugins.description: /re tests a regular expression on a text and lists each match with its position and capture groups

plugins.name: http-probe
plugins.description: /http makes a GET request and shows the status, content type, size and first lines of the body

plugins.name: snippets
plugins.description: /snip saves reusable prompt snippets across sessions and puts one in the prompt box by name

plugins.name: export-session
plugins.description: /save-session writes the conversation so far as Markdown under .claude-exports in the project

plugins.name: standup
plugins.description: /standup lists your commits since yesterday morning in this repository, grouped by day and ready to paste

plugins.name: error-notify
plugins.description: Sends a native notification when a turn ends on an error or a refusal

plugins.name: needs-you-notify
plugins.description: Sends a native notification when Claude stops to ask you a question or needs your permission

plugins.name: agent-done-notify
plugins.description: Sends a native notification when a subagent that ran for 30 seconds or more finishes

plugins.name: long-cmd-notify
plugins.description: Sends a native notification when a shell command that ran two minutes or more finishes

plugins.name: tests-notify
plugins.description: Sends a native notification with pass or fail when a test run of 30 seconds or more finishes

plugins.name: ci-notify
plugins.description: Polls GitHub Actions every two minutes and notifies once when a running workflow completes

plugins.name: pr-review-notify
plugins.description: Polls the current branch's pull request every three minutes and notifies once when its review decision changes

plugins.name: rate-limit-notify
plugins.description: Sends a native notification the first time a rate limit window passes 90%, with when it resets

plugins.name: hydrate
plugins.description: Toast every 60 minutes of real use reminding you to drink water

plugins.name: posture
plugins.description: Toast every 30 minutes of use with one short posture check, rotating through four

plugins.name: eye-rest
plugins.description: The 20-20-20 rule: every 20 minutes of use, look 20 feet away for 20 seconds

plugins.name: stand-up
plugins.description: Toast after two hours of use without a 10 minute break: stand up and walk

plugins.name: alarms
plugins.description: /alarm sets daily alarms at a local time, kept across sessions, with a toast and a notification

plugins.name: remind
plugins.description: /remind <minutes> <text> fires a toast and a notification after that many minutes

plugins.name: timebox
plugins.description: /timebox <minutes> <what> counts down on the status line, warns at 80% and notifies at the end

plugins.name: session-cap
plugins.description: Toast after three hours of continuous use in one session, then again every hour

plugins.name: late-night
plugins.description: One toast per session when you work after 23:00 local time: it is late, park the work

plugins.name: intent-check
plugins.description: /intent says what the session is for; every 30 minutes of use a toast asks if you are still on it

plugins.name: daily-target
plugins.description: /target sets a daily commit goal for this repository; toasts at half and at the goal

plugins.name: weekly-recap
plugins.description: On the first session of a new week, one toast with last week's days active, sessions and prompts

plugins.name: breathe
plugins.description: /breathe guides one minute of breathing through toasts: in 4, hold 4, out 6, five rounds

plugins.name: diff-pane
plugins.description: /edits opens a pane with every Edit and Write of the session, lines added and removed, newest first

plugins.name: turn-history
plugins.description: /turns opens a pane with one row per finished turn: duration, tool calls, output tokens and a cross for failed ones

plugins.name: prompt-history
plugins.description: /prompts opens a pane with the prompts you typed this session; press one to put it back in the prompt box

plugins.name: agent-pane
plugins.description: /crew opens a pane with the session's subagents, their type and status, refreshed while any is running

plugins.name: token-chart
plugins.description: /tokens opens a pane with output tokens per turn as thin gauges scaled to the largest turn

plugins.name: cost-pane
plugins.description: /spend opens a pane with the cost of each turn, the difference of the session cost, and the total

plugins.name: error-pane
plugins.description: /errors opens a pane with every tool call that failed or was denied, its input and the first line of the error

plugins.name: context-pane
plugins.description: /window opens a pane with the context window by category, each with a gauge and its share, and a Refresh button

plugins.name: read-pane
plugins.description: /reads opens a pane with the files read this session and how often; files read 3 or more times are flagged as wasted context

plugins.name: links-pane
plugins.description: /links opens a pane with the URLs that appeared in Claude's answers; press one to copy it

plugins.name: git-pane
plugins.description: /repo opens a pane with the branch, ahead and behind, the changed files and the last 8 commits

plugins.name: branch-pane
plugins.description: /branches opens a pane with the local branches, the current one marked, ahead and behind and the age of the last commit

plugins.name: stash-pane
plugins.description: /stashes opens a pane with the stash list: index, branch, message and how old each one is

plugins.name: code-todo-pane
plugins.description: /codetodo opens a pane with the TODO, FIXME and HACK lines in tracked files, grouped by tag

plugins.name: deps-pane
plugins.description: /deps opens a pane with npm outdated as a table, major jumps in red and minor ones in amber

plugins.name: scripts-pane
plugins.description: /scripts opens a pane with the scripts of package.json; pressing one asks Claude to run it and fix what fails

plugins.name: env-keys-pane
plugins.description: /envkeys compares the keys of .env.example with .env and lists the missing and the extra ones, never a value

plugins.name: test-pane
plugins.description: /testlog opens a pane with every test run of the session: command, pass or fail, duration and time

plugins.name: slow-toast
plugins.description: A toast when a shell command took a minute or more, with the command and how long it ran

plugins.name: deny-toast
plugins.description: A toast whenever a tool call is refused, naming the tool and the first line of the reason

plugins.name: big-output-toast
plugins.description: A toast when one tool result is larger than 20,000 characters, since that much output eats the context

plugins.name: time-context
plugins.description: Every prompt carries the current local date, weekday, time and UTC offset so relative dates resolve right

plugins.name: os-context
plugins.description: Tells Claude your operating system, shell and installed node, python, java and git versions

plugins.name: test-first
plugins.description: /tdd turns on test-first work: a failing test before the code, run before and after

plugins.name: explain-mode
plugins.description: /explain makes Claude explain each change in one or two sentences, for someone learning the codebase

plugins.name: plan-first
plugins.description: /plan-first makes Claude list the files and the order before editing a change that spans more than two files

plugins.name: no-comments
plugins.description: Keeps comments that restate the code, banners and commented-out code out; only the why stays

plugins.name: minimal-diff
plugins.description: Asks for the smallest change that solves the request, with no drive-by refactors; findings are mentioned instead

plugins.name: ask-first
plugins.description: When a request has two readings that lead to different code, Claude asks one short question first

plugins.name: verify-claims
plugins.description: Claude does not say something works without running it, and ends with what was and was not verified

plugins.name: paste-fence
plugins.description: Wraps a pasted block of 6+ lines of code or logs in a code fence before it is sent, leaving your sentences outside

plugins.name: file-mention-hint
plugins.description: When a prompt names a file without a path, adds the matching tracked paths so Claude opens the right file first

plugins.name: trace-helper
plugins.description: Adds a hidden hint to prompts with a stack trace: find the first project frame, read it, state the root cause

plugins.name: sudo-guard
plugins.description: Blocks privilege elevation: sudo, doas, su -c, runas and Start-Process -Verb RunAs

plugins.name: chmod-guard
plugins.description: Blocks world-writable permissions, recursive chown on root or home, and icacls grants to Everyone

plugins.name: docker-guard
plugins.description: Asks before destructive Docker commands: system prune, volume rm or prune, rm -f, rmi -f and compose down -v

plugins.name: kill-guard
plugins.description: Blocks broad process kills: kill -1, killall, loose pkill, taskkill on system or wildcard names, Stop-Process -Name *

plugins.name: credential-file-guard
plugins.description: Blocks reading or copying SSH keys, cloud and registry credentials and shell history, with Read and in the shell

plugins.name: upload-guard
plugins.description: Asks before a command sends a local file out: curl uploads, wget --post-file, scp or rsync to a host, nc

plugins.name: env-dump-guard
plugins.description: Blocks dumping the whole environment: bare env, printenv, set and export -p, Get-ChildItem Env:

plugins.name: registry-guard
plugins.description: Asks before a command changes where packages come from: npm, pnpm, yarn and pip registry or index settings

plugins.name: persistence-guard
plugins.description: Asks before a command that makes something run on its own later: cron, schtasks, systemd, launchd or a Startup folder

plugins.name: dotfile-guard
plugins.description: Blocks edits to your shell and tool profiles: .bashrc, .zshrc, .gitconfig, .ssh/config and the PowerShell profile

plugins.name: ci-config-guard
plugins.description: Asks before an edit to pipeline and deploy configuration: GitHub workflows, GitLab CI, Jenkinsfile, vercel.json, eas.json

plugins.name: test-skip-guard
plugins.description: Refuses an edit that adds a skipped or focused test: .skip, .only, xit, fit, @Ignore, @Disabled, @pytest.mark.skip

plugins.name: suppress-guard
plugins.description: Refuses an edit that adds a blanket suppression: eslint-disable, @ts-ignore, @ts-nocheck, bare # noqa or # type: ignore

plugins.name: migration-guard
plugins.description: Refuses edits to existing database migrations (Prisma, Rails, Django, Alembic, Flyway); a new file is the fix

plugins.name: large-write-guard
plugins.description: Refuses a Write over 1,500 lines or 200 KB and asks for the file to be split or generated by a script

plugins.name: tunnel-guard
plugins.description: Asks before a command that exposes your machine to the internet: ngrok, cloudflared, ssh -R, tailscale funnel, a dev server on 0.0.0.0

plugins.name: reread-guard
plugins.description: Refuses reading again a file Claude already read this session when it has not changed, once, with a reason

plugins.name: grep-limit
plugins.description: Caps a Grep that prints matching lines at 100 lines and tells Claude when the cap cut the answer

plugins.name: read-cap
plugins.description: Reads only the first 600 lines of a file over 150 KB and tells Claude how to continue with offset

plugins.name: git-log-limit
plugins.description: Adds -n 30 to a git log that has no limit, so the history does not flood the context

plugins.name: paste-size-toast
plugins.description: A toast when the prompt you send is very large, with its size in lines and tokens, so you can trim a pasted log

plugins.name: cat-guard
plugins.description: Refuses cat, type and Get-Content on a file over 100 KB and points to a slice or Grep

plugins.name: explore-nudge
plugins.description: After 15 reads and searches in one turn, a toast and a note to Claude to hand the rest of the exploring to a subagent

plugins.name: fill-toast
plugins.description: A toast when the context window jumps 10 points or more in one step, naming the last tool that ran

plugins.name: cache-cold-toast
plugins.description: A toast when you send a prompt after the 5 minute prompt-cache window expired on a large context

plugins.name: flood-note
plugins.description: Tells Claude when a search or command returned over 300 lines, so it narrows the next one instead of repeating it

plugins.name: heavy-calls
plugins.description: /heavy lists the five tool results that took the most context this session, with tool, target and size

plugins.name: tree-flood-guard
plugins.description: Refuses an unfiltered find, ls -R or dir /s that would list node_modules, and suggests git ls-files or Glob

plugins.name: commit-review
plugins.description: Asks you to look at the diff before a big commit goes through, showing the files and lines staged

plugins.name: wip-commit-guard
plugins.description: Refuses commits whose message is wip, fix, asdf, a dot or similar, so the history says what changed

plugins.name: marker-guard
plugins.description: Refuses a commit whose staged changes still hold conflict markers, listing the files

plugins.name: amend-guard
plugins.description: Asks before git commit --amend or git rebase rewrites commits that are already on a remote branch

plugins.name: stage-guard
plugins.description: Refuses git add -A, git add . and git commit -a while a .env, key or certificate is waiting to be staged

plugins.name: git-stage
plugins.description: /stage lists what is staged, unstaged and new; /stage <paths> stages them and -r unstages, asking first

plugins.name: git-fixup
plugins.description: /fixup commits the staged changes as a fixup of HEAD or any commit, ready for rebase --autosquash

plugins.name: git-sync
plugins.description: /sync fetches and shows how far the branch is from its base; /sync rebase or merge brings the base in after asking

plugins.name: behind-toast
plugins.description: Toast when your branch falls 10, 20, 30 commits behind its base, before the conflicts pile up

plugins.name: git-switch
plugins.description: /gsw switches branch carrying your uncommitted work: stashes it, switches, and offers it back when you return

plugins.name: git-tag
plugins.description: /gtag shows the latest tag and the commits since; /gtag patch, minor or major creates the next version tag after asking

plugins.name: staged-status
plugins.description: Status line with how many files are staged, unstaged and new, hidden when the tree is clean

plugins.name: untested-turn-toast
plugins.description: Toast at the end of a turn that changed code without running a single test

plugins.name: red-turn-toast
plugins.description: Toast when a turn ends while the last test run is still failing

plugins.name: debugger-guard
plugins.description: Refuses edits that add a debugger statement, breakpoint(), pdb or binding.pry

plugins.name: leftovers-toast
plugins.description: Toast at the end of a turn counting the debug logs and TODOs the edits added

plugins.name: any-guard
plugins.description: Asks before an edit adds any to TypeScript: ": any", "as any", "<any>" or any[]

plugins.name: long-file-toast
plugins.description: Toast when an edit takes a file past 500 lines, and again at every 100 more

plugins.name: dup-block-guard
plugins.description: Refuses an edit whose new code repeats a block of 6 or more lines already in the same file

plugins.name: untested
plugins.description: /untested lists the changed files that have no test file, without spending a model turn

plugins.name: coverage-status
plugins.description: Status line with the line coverage of the last report in the project, and how far it moved

plugins.name: empty-test-guard
plugins.description: Refuses a test file edit that adds test cases with no assertion in them

plugins.name: snapshot-update-guard
plugins.description: Asks before a command rewrites test snapshots: jest -u, vitest -u, --snapshot-update, insta accept

plugins.name: catch-swallow-guard
plugins.description: Refuses edits that add an empty catch block or an except that only passes

plugins.name: pm-guard
plugins.description: Refuses npm, pnpm, yarn or bun commands that use a different package manager than the project's lockfile, and names the right one

plugins.name: script-guard
plugins.description: Refuses npm run or pnpm run of a script that package.json does not declare and lists the ones it does

plugins.name: missing-import-guard
plugins.description: Refuses an edit that imports a package which is neither in package.json nor in node_modules

plugins.name: client-env-guard
plugins.description: Refuses browser code in Vite and Next.js that reads an env variable the bundler never exposes

plugins.name: next-boundary-guard
plugins.description: Refuses Next.js app router edits that break the client/server boundary: hooks without 'use client', or server-only code inside a client file

plugins.name: esm-guard
plugins.description: Refuses require, module.exports and __dirname in .js files of a package that declares "type": "module"

plugins.name: alias-import-guard
plugins.description: Refuses deep ../../ imports when tsconfig paths has an alias for the folder, and names the alias to use

plugins.name: dev-server-guard
plugins.description: Asks before npm run dev, next dev or vite starts while something already answers on that dev server's port

plugins.name: ts-config-context
plugins.description: Tells Claude your tsconfig in the system prompt: strict flags, path aliases, module resolution and type-only imports

plugins.name: env-undeclared-toast
plugins.description: A toast when an edit reads process.env or import.meta.env variables that .env.example does not declare

plugins.name: node-version-status
plugins.description: Status line entry that shows only when the running Node does not satisfy engines.node, .nvmrc or .node-version

plugins.name: pm-command
plugins.description: /pm names the project's package manager and shows its install, add, remove, run and exec commands

plugins.name: runtime-band
plugins.description: Band that appears when the Node, Python or Java version the project asks for differs from the one installed

plugins.name: docker-band
plugins.description: Band that warns when the Docker daemon is down or a compose stack has services stopped

plugins.name: env-drift-band
plugins.description: Band with the keys .env.example has and .env lacks, names only, never values

plugins.name: deploy-status
plugins.description: Status line entry with the result of the last deploy command: vercel, netlify, eas, firebase, fly and others

plugins.name: todo-new-status
plugins.description: Status line counting the TODO, FIXME and HACK lines added to the code in this session

plugins.name: release-status
plugins.description: Status line with the package version, the latest tag and the commits waiting for the next release

plugins.name: license-status
plugins.description: Status line that warns when the project has no license file or no license field in package.json

plugins.name: install-status
plugins.description: Status line that warns when node_modules is missing or older than the lockfile

plugins.name: db-port-status
plugins.description: Status line that warns when the local database or cache the project points to is not listening

plugins.name: migration-status
plugins.description: Status line with the migration files created and not yet committed, ready to apply

plugins.name: env-ignore-status
plugins.description: Status line that warns when a .env file is tracked by git or missing from .gitignore

plugins.name: build-size-status
plugins.description: Status line with the size of the build output and how much it grew in this session

plugins.name: hardcoded-secret-guard
plugins.description: Asks before an edit puts a hardcoded password, connection string or JWT into source

plugins.name: private-host-guard
plugins.description: Asks before an edit adds a private IP address or an internal hostname to source

plugins.name: dynamic-exec-guard
plugins.description: Asks before an edit adds eval, new Function, innerHTML or a shell command built from a variable

plugins.name: sql-concat-guard
plugins.description: Asks before an edit builds an SQL statement by joining strings or interpolating values

plugins.name: tls-off-guard
plugins.description: Asks before TLS certificate verification is switched off in code or in a command

plugins.name: cors-open-guard
plugins.description: Asks before an edit opens CORS to every origin with * or a bare cors()

plugins.name: debug-flag-guard
plugins.description: Asks before an edit leaves a debug flag on, exposes every actuator endpoint or sets development mode in a production file

plugins.name: script-mode-guard
plugins.description: Asks before a script or config gets a world-writable mode, umask 0 or an Everyone grant

plugins.name: dep-source-guard
plugins.description: Asks before a dependency is pinned to a git URL or tarball, or pulled over plain http

plugins.name: weak-crypto-guard
plugins.description: Asks before an edit hashes passwords with MD5 or SHA-1, makes tokens with Math.random, or picks ECB or an unsigned JWT

plugins.name: gitignore-guard
plugins.description: Asks before a .gitignore edit drops an entry that protects .env, keys or credentials, or git add -f forces one in

plugins.name: archive-add-guard
plugins.description: Asks before git add stages an archive, installer or database file, or any file over 5 MB

plugins.name: budget-alert
plugins.description: /budget <usd> sets a session budget: a toast at 80% and a native notification when the cost passes it

plugins.name: daily-budget-alert
plugins.description: /daybudget <usd> sets a budget for the day across sessions and notifies once when the day's total passes it

plugins.name: turn-toast
plugins.description: Shows a toast summarizing every finished turn of 10 seconds or more: duration, tool calls and output tokens

plugins.name: milestone-toast
plugins.description: Shows a toast when the session reaches 10, 25, 50 and 100 prompts

plugins.name: push-reminder
plugins.description: Shows a toast when the branch has been three or more commits ahead of its upstream for an hour

plugins.name: idle-commit-nudge
plugins.description: Shows a toast when the session has been idle for 10 minutes with uncommitted changes

plugins.name: timeline
plugins.description: /timeline opens a chronological log of the session: prompts, tool calls, failures and turn ends with their clock time

plugins.name: branch-naming
plugins.description: Teaches Claude the branch naming convention: feat/, fix/, chore/, refactor/, docs/ and never new work on main

plugins.name: pr-style
plugins.description: Makes pull request descriptions follow what changed, why, how tested and risks, with a Conventional Commits title

plugins.name: a11y-rules
plugins.description: In web projects, keeps Claude to accessibility rules when editing markup: labels, alt text, keyboard, focus, contrast

plugins.name: security-rules
plugins.description: Always-on security rules: validate input, parameterized queries, no secrets in code or logs, least privilege, TLS on

plugins.name: react-rules
plugins.description: In React projects, keeps Claude to the rules of hooks, stable keys, derived state and effects only for synchronization

plugins.name: tailwind-rules
plugins.description: In Tailwind projects, keeps Claude on theme tokens, scale steps and mobile-first, without inline styles

plugins.name: rn-rules
plugins.description: In React Native and Expo projects, keeps Claude on FlatList, StyleSheet, Platform checks and EAS-compatible config

plugins.name: java-rules
plugins.description: In Java projects, keeps Claude on constructor injection, try-with-resources, no swallowed exceptions and the declared Java version

plugins.name: oracle-rules
plugins.description: In Oracle projects, makes Claude write SQL that runs on Oracle 11g: ROWNUM, sequences with triggers, bind variables, MERGE

plugins.name: answer-format
plugins.description: /format sets the shape of answers (bullets, steps, table or prose) and shows it in the status line

plugins.name: loc-count
plugins.description: /loc counts lines of code by file type for the project or a path, with a total

plugins.name: big-files
plugins.description: /big lists the largest tracked files of the project with readable sizes

plugins.name: recent-files
plugins.description: /recent lists the files changed most recently, with when, from the last 100 commits

plugins.name: symbol-def
plugins.description: /def finds where a function, class, type or variable is defined in the tracked files

plugins.name: file-author
plugins.description: /who shows who last touched a file or folder, when, and who changed it most

plugins.name: head-file
plugins.description: /head shows the first numbered lines of a project file, and never prints files that hold secrets

plugins.name: file-diff
plugins.description: /fdiff shows what changed in one file since the last commit, without printing secret files

plugins.name: path-size
plugins.description: /size shows how big a file is, in bytes and lines, or a folder, in tracked size and files

plugins.name: ignore-check
plugins.description: /ignored tells whether git ignores a path and which rule does it

plugins.name: file-compare
plugins.description: /cmp shows how one project file differs from another, and refuses files that hold secrets

plugins.name: churn
plugins.description: /churn lists the files changed in the most commits among the last 300, lockfiles left out

plugins.name: hit-count
plugins.description: /hits counts how many times a text appears in each tracked file, most first

plugins.name: topic-switch
plugins.description: Toast when a prompt shares nothing with the work in progress after several edits, before a second task mixes into the first
